When imuxsock is configured with UsePIDFromSystem="on" or SysSock.UsePIDFromSystem="on", its special parser rewrites the message TAG with the kernel-supplied process ID through fixPID(). For a message with an empty TAG, the parsed TAG length is zero. fixPID() then computes an offset of -1 and copies the "[<pid>]:" suffix starting one byte before the stack-allocated TAG buffer.
When imuxsock plain trusted-property annotation is enabled, a local process can inject additional fields into the appended trusted-property block through its process name or executable path.
